body.statement:
For a nested flag \(V1\subset V2\), full-row-rank bases \(B1,B2\), nonnegative integers \(a,b,e\) with \(a+b+e>0\), and \(\lambda_0\neq0\), the polynomial \(D_{\mathrm{flag}}=\lambda_0\Delta_1^a\Delta_2^b\delta^e\) satisfies
\[
 2\operatorname{tr}\{(G_{D_{\mathrm{flag}}}(X)X)^2\}
 =2\bigl((a+b+e)^2+(b+e)^2+e^2\bigr)D_{\mathrm{flag}}(X)^2
\]
identically on \(S3\).

source.locator: Theorem 1, self-normalization identity for nested flag powers
